Here’s a chocolate cake recipe:

**Simple Chocolate Cake**  
**Ingredients (8 servings)**
- 250 g plain flour  
- 200 g sugar  
- 50 g cocoa powder  
- 2 tsp baking powder  
- 1 tsp baking soda  
- 1 pinch salt  
- 2 eggs  
- 240 ml milk  
- 120 ml vegetable oil  
- 2 tsp vanilla extract  
- 240 ml hot water  
- 115 g butter  
- 300 g icing sugar  
- 25 g cocoa powder  
- 30 ml milk  

**Method**
- Heat the oven to 180°C and grease and line a round cake tin or two sandwich tins.
- Mix the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
- Add the eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla, then beat until smooth.
- Stir in the hot water. The batter will be thin.
- Pour into the tin and bake until a skewer comes out clean, about 30 to 35 minutes.
- Cool completely.
- To make the frosting, beat the butter until smooth, then mix in the icing sugar, cocoa powder, and milk until fluffy.
- Spread the frosting over the cooled cake and serve.

Eggless Chocolate Cake

Ingredients:
- 250 g plain flour
- 50 g cocoa powder
- 200 g sugar
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 pinch salt
- 240 ml water
- 120 ml vegetable oil
- 1 tbsp white vinegar
- 2 tsp vanilla extract

Method:
- Heat the oven to 180°C and line or grease an 8-inch cake tin.
- In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
- Add the water, vegetable oil, vinegar, and vanilla extract. Stir until just combined and smooth.
- Pour the batter into the prepared tin and level the top.
- Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
- Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a rack to cool completely.
- Serve plain, dusted with icing sugar, or topped with your favorite chocolate frosting.

Classic Beef Lasagne

Summary: A rich, hearty lasagne with a savory beef tomato sauce, creamy béchamel, and plenty of melted cheese.

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion
- 1 carrot
- 2 celery stalks
- 3 garlic cloves
- 500 g ground beef
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 800 g crushed tomatoes
- 250 ml beef stock
- 2 tsp dried oregano
- 2 tsp dried basil
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 50 g butter
- 50 g plain flour
- 750 ml milk
- 1 pinch nutmeg
- 12 lasagne sheets
- 50 g parmesan cheese
- 200 g mozzarella cheese

Method:
- Heat the oven to 190°C.
- Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery, and garlic.
- Heat the olive oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrot, and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until softened.
- Add the garlic and ground beef, breaking up the meat, and cook until browned.
- Stir in the tomato paste, then add the crushed tomatoes, beef stock, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper.
- Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes until thick and rich.
- To make the béchamel, melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour, and cook for 1 minute.
- Gradually whisk in the milk and cook, stirring, until smooth and thick. Season with nutmeg and a little salt.
- Spread a thin layer of meat sauce in a baking dish, then top with lasagne sheets, more meat sauce, a little béchamel, and a sprinkle of parmesan.
- Repeat the layers, finishing with béchamel, mozzarella, and the remaining parmesan on top.
- Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

Yes — here’s a banana bread recipe:

**Banana Bread**  
Makes 8 servings, about 70 minutes

**Ingredients**
- 3 ripe bananas
- 250 g plain flour
- 150 g sugar
- 2 eggs
- 100 g butter
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 pinch salt
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Method**
- Heat the oven to 175°C and grease or line a loaf tin.
- Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then stir in the melted butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
- In a second bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
- Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined.
- Pour into the loaf tin and smooth the top.
- Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
- Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely before slicing.
